name: Word Duels 🧠
desc:
Can you guess the SECRET word?

Welcome to Word Duels, a game where you have to guess a 5 letter word

⚔️ Duel your friends and guess the word
💰 Earn cash by participating or winning the duel
🏆 Become the best in the leaderboards
🪑 Buy the best chairs in the game

👍 Like the game and join the group for future updates!
